name: proposals
description: Pick how Claude presents its proposals, from a row above the prompt or /proposals. visual: anything visual (mockups, layouts, palettes, logos) goes in an artifact, text choices stay as questions in the terminal. artifact: every proposal with options goes in an artifact. terminal: everything stays in the terminal, ASCII mockups included. default: the mod sends Claude no rule. Each format keeps your own instructions; left empty, Claude decides the layout and style.
